استحسنوا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْسَنُوا (istaḥsanū) /is.taħ.sa.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَحْسَنَ (istaḥsana)
# اُسْتُحْسِنُوا (ustuḥsinū) /us.tuħ.si.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْسَنَ (istaḥsana)
# اِسْتَحْسِنُوا (istaḥsinū) /is.taħ.si.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْسَنَ (istaḥsana)
